description: Given a central J-Grants subsidy id, search for municipal grants that supplement it (e.g. national "事業再構築" + city-level "事業再構築追加上乗せ"). Heuristic: matches base title tokens across municipal records of the same/similar category. Returns up to 30. Free.

prefecture.description: Restrict to municipalities of a single prefecture

name: find_supplementary_grants
